faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ramanujan College Principal recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Ramanujan College Principal recruitment is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. Degree, and have served as a Professor or Associate Professor with at least 15 years of teaching or research experience. Additionally, a minimum of 10 research publications and an 110 Research Score are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Principal post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Principal at Ramanujan College, Delhi University, as per the latest notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 2000/-. Specific details for other categories, if any, should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Principal position?
faq.answer: The Principal post will be compensated as per Academic Pay Level 14 of the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Principal recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening by a committee, followed by a selection committee interview, document verification, and finally, the creation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Ramanujan College Principal recruitment must be submitted online through the official website. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related criteria or relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Ramanujan College?
faq.answer: The official website of Ramanujan College is www.ramanujancollege.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information and to access the application portal.
